about: One-item rounds for the formats the larger examples only imply. Each folder is an honest round that must PASS, and each *-broken folder is a copy where the seller applied the wrong rule or ignored a top-up, which must FAIL on the checks listed.

rounds.name: second-price
rounds.story: One item, the winner pays the highest losing bid (Vickrey).

rounds.name: first-price
rounds.story: One item, the winner pays their own bid.

rounds.name: top-up
rounds.story: One item, first price. Alice pays 3,000,000 and later 3,000,000 more under the same memo, so her bid is 6,000,000.

rounds.name: second-price-broken
rounds.story: The seller charges the second-price winner their whole bid, 3,000,000, and sends no change, instead of the highest losing bid, 1,500,000.

rounds.name: first-price-broken
rounds.story: The seller charges the first-price winner only the highest losing bid.

rounds.name: top-up-broken
rounds.story: The seller counts only the first of Alice's two payments, so her bid looks like 3,000,000 instead of 6,000,000.
